Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Increased the optional debug capture limit from 25 MB to 75 MB. Improved DoT snapshots for variable-strength Damage Down and Thunder replacements, corrected snapshot selection around refresh confirmation, and prevented exhausted Thunder, Baneful Impaction, and Combust III effects from taking another effect's damage. Direct-hit estimates remain diagnostic-only.
